description.narrative: ASA Pakistan, is a rapidly growing microfinance institution primarily targeting women micro-entrepreneurs, in a country that ranks 147 out of 188 countries according to the gender inequality index produced by the United Nations. Funding is needed to finance the institution's growth. In the trajectory to apply for a Microfinance Bank license, ASA Pakistan is strengthening its organization, systems and procedures. FMO's financing is expected to bring funding stability to the balance sheet of the institution alongside other international funders.
